descriptions:
Oak Family 4-Seater Sofa Pet Friendly Washable Cover  

The Oak Family Sofa features a spacious 4-seater design that provides comfortable seating for family and guests. Its pet-friendly fabric helps resist scratches and makes cleaning easier for households with pets. Washable covers allow convenient maintenance while keeping the sofa clean and fresh.

Oak Family Wooden Table Heavy Duty Easy Clean Surface  

The Oak Family Wooden Table is built with a stable structure that supports heavy weight capacity for daily use. Its smooth surface is easy to clean and maintain, making it practical for homes and offices. The durable wooden construction provides both functionality and a modern appearance
